lines.text: 示意的小咖啡店，同一包豆子，有兩種做法。
示意的手沖，一杯要等四分鐘，一天賣三十杯。
示意的義式，一杯只要一分鐘，一天賣九十杯。
示意算下來，手沖一杯一百八，義式一杯六十，一天的營收一樣多。
所以示意的老闆兩種都留著，早上賣義式，下午賣手沖。

t2i: A medium-wide view of a clean wooden cafe counter. On the left stands a glass pour-over dripper on a small stand with a gooseneck kettle beside it; on the right stands a compact espresso machine with a small cup under its spout. One open paper bag of coffee beans sits in the centre between them.
Behind the counter is a calm, uncluttered off-white wall with generous empty space in the upper half of the frame. No people.
two_brews.scene: A pour-over dripper with a gooseneck kettle on the left and a compact espresso machine on the right of a wooden cafe counter, one open bag of coffee beans between them
two_brews.ident: Preserve the pour-over dripper, the gooseneck kettle, the espresso machine, the bag of coffee beans, the wooden counter and the clean off-white wall
acts: A thin stream of coffee drips from the pour-over dripper into the glass server below it.
A short stream of espresso runs from the machine into the small cup, and a little steam rises from both.
two_brews.camera: Static medium-wide shot, locked-off, no camera movement.
